title: One peer cap, three pins: unblocking the demos dependency group
description: GH-4098's npm-minor-patch group for orchestkit-demos failed the Validate Renderer check with an npm ERESOLVE conflict: @react-three/fiber 9.7.0 peers on react >=19 <19.3 and the group bumped react to 19.3.0. Interactive peer checker plus the two hidden traps the lockfile regen exposed: remotion caret ranges drifting to mixed versions, and the zod split that warns of failed renders. Resolution by pinning, with dependabot ignores so the failure does not reopen weekly.
